name: @miyoria/memory
description: memory: Long-term memory: consolidation, hybrid retrieval, privacy scopes, followups, memory tools and commands; facts: The V3 fact layer: EventLog, Observation adapters, Working Context and the DeliveryLedger; learning: Reflection and learning: continuous conversation compaction, her self-organized knowledge, feedback signals, lessons and daily reflection (modules `conversation`, `knowledge`, `reflect`); notes: Her documents, one per person, place, topic and herself, written line by line with provenance and evidence, and the segment pass that writes them; transcript: Session transcripts kept on disk in the model's message form, with compaction; world: What she perceives (module `world`): presence, voice states, channel activity, her own status and salient changes
